scripts.build: bun run generate:app-config && bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.dev: bun run generate:app-config && bun run --filter app --filter server --parallel dev
scripts.test:live-composio: bun -e "if (!process.env.COMPOSIO_API_KEY?.trim()) { console.error('COMPOSIO_API_KEY is empty or unset, so every case in this suite would skip and this command would still exit 0. Run it as COMPOSIO_API_KEY=... bun run test:live-composio.'); process.exit(1) }" && OPENBOT_LIVE_COMPOSIO=1 bun test server/tests/composio-live.test.ts
scripts.test:live-codesandbox: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first.'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/codesandbox-smoke.ts
scripts.test:live-sandbox-isolation: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first.'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/sandbox-isolation-smoke.ts
scripts.test:live-workshop: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first, and have the server running (see WORKSHOP_SMOKE_SERVER_URL).'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/workshop-smoke.ts
